document.title: Probe, fix, verify — a capped repair loop

stages.title: Probe the studio
stages.prompt: Probe the Pipeline Studio copy in `studio/` for legibility defects, in a real headless browser. Measure the six clauses the pipeline's contract names (seed rendered, no page errors, every card named, role/meta lines at 12px or more, nothing inside a card below 10px, bundle.json carrying four documents) and write `out/probe.json`: one finding per clause with the number that decided it. Do not fix anything — the next stage does that.

stages.title: Fix what the probe found
stages.prompt: Read `out/probe.json` and fix ONLY the clauses that failed, in the tree's own copy of the studio. Each fix is a real edit to `studio/app.css`; record the file, the rule, and the sha256 before and after in `out/fix.json`. A clause the stylesheet does not hold in the shape you expect is reported as unfixable, never invented.

stages.title: Verify the fix
stages.prompt: Re-measure every clause in the same browser and write `out/verify.json`: for each clause, what it measured before, what it measures now, which previously-failing clauses are fixed, which are still open, and any clause the fix broke that was passing before.
